value.rationale: Pseudo-Frobenius type is a natural numerical-semigroup and semigroup-ring invariant. The uniform exact type expectation and Gaussian law complete a different statistical aspect of the contemporary joint Frobenius/genus/multiplicity enumeration. The invariant cannot be deduced from genus and embedding dimension alone, as a same-(m,F,g,e) type-2 versus type-3 counterexample shows. The residue-chain product is a structural uniform correction, not arbitrary finite data.
